How booking works

Three steps, no app needed

1

Pick your service

Choose a haircut, beard, shave, spa — or a combo — and a time that suits you. We're open 24 hours, so early morning and late night slots are real.

2

Send it on WhatsApp

One tap sends your booking to the shop's WhatsApp (+974 6000 6784) with all the details filled in. No account, no form spam.

3

Get confirmed, walk in

The shop replies on WhatsApp to confirm your chair. Just show up at your time — your barber will be ready.
